g.text: PIERS SNAP INTO THE 7 MM HOLES
CROSS PLATE - FOAM SLOPES ON THE RIVER SIDE
River crossing - module base (cut 2: West + East). Module height 70.09 mm with the feet at 12 mm (adjust 9.5 to 16.0); plywood box 58.09 mm
5mm Material or 1/4" Ply 0.22" Actual - cut 2 sets - assemble the East module as a mirror image (flip every part)
